lyrics:
[Intro: sparkling synth arpeggio, gated drums]

[Verse 1: bright female voice, breathless]
I've been writing it in margins, on the fog of the glass
Saying it at stoplights, in the back of my class
My friends all think I've met someone, and I guess I have
There's a name I can't stop saying and it's making me laugh

[Pre-Chorus: building, bass pulsing]
Two little syllables, soft at the start
Goes off like a firework in the dark

[Chorus: big, glossy, joyful]
Say it again, say it again
I just love the way it sounds
Say it when I'm up, say it when I'm lost
Say it and the walls come down
Sweetest thing I've ever said
Say it again, say it again

[Verse 2: voice lower, awed]
It was whispered to a girl by an angel in the night
Shouted at a storm, and the storm got quiet
Nailed above a cross in three languages for shame
And death itself gave up when it heard that name

[Pre-Chorus: building, bass pulsing]
Two little syllables, here it comes
Every knee, every star, every tongue

[Chorus: big, glossy, joyful, the name sung]
Jesus, Jesus
I just love the way it sounds
Say it when I'm up, say it when I'm lost
Say it and the walls come down
Sweetest thing I've ever said
Jesus, Jesus

[Bridge: half-time, voices stacking]
Name over every name I know
Over my fear, over my shame, over my grave
Say it (Jesus), say it (Jesus)

[Final Chorus: key change up, everything brighter]
Jesus, Jesus
I just love the way it sounds
Say it when I'm up, say it when I'm lost
Say it and the walls come down
Sweetest thing I've ever said
Jesus, Jesus

[Outro: synth arpeggio, one whisper]
Jesus.
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 118 BPM, 4/4, A major, lifting to B major for the final chorus. Bright, quick and giddy, like running to tell someone.

VOICE: Female, clear and bright with a little breathiness, sounding delighted. The second verse is sung lower and more slowly. Stacked harmonies in the choruses and a crowd of voices answering in the bridge. One whispered word to finish.

INSTRUMENTS: A sparkling synth arpeggio, big gated-reverb drums, a pulsing synth bass, clean chorused electric guitar, glassy keyboard chords, a string pad in the bridge, handclaps.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro arpeggio. 0:10 Verse 1. 0:34 Pre-chorus. 0:42 Chorus 1. 1:02 Verse 2, where the name has been. 1:26 Pre-chorus. 1:34 Chorus 2, the name. 1:54 Bridge, half-time. 2:18 Final chorus, key up. 2:46 Outro, arpeggio and a whisper at 3:14.

PRODUCTION & MIX: 1980s-style synth-pop made with modern clarity: glossy, wide, big snare, voice bright on top.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The chorus melody returning with the name in place of 'say it again' at 1:34.

THE REVEAL: Verse 1 is a girl with a crush. Verse 2 at 1:02 gives the angel, the storm and the sign on the cross, and the chorus that follows finally sings the two syllables.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Giddy, teasing, awed, overjoyed.
